Q5361.reason: Conspiracy to commit bank robbery requires an agreement to rob a bank; lending a gun knowing only that the friend wanted to "make some money" supplies no such agreement.

Q5367.reason: Interstate news gathering and distribution is commerce Congress may regulate; supremacy is not an independent power, the copyright clause does not cover source privilege, and Congress cannot expand a First Amendment privilege the Court has not recognized.

Q5371.reason: Marathon success depends on thermoregulation, oxygen delivery, and glycogen stores; muscle ATP and phosphocreatine support only seconds of effort and are not limiting in prolonged endurance events.
